primaryChecks.text: Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron. (The name of Hebron before that was Kiriath Arba.) They struck Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.
primaryChecks.nextContext: From there he went against the inhabitants of Debir. (The name of Debir before that was Kiriath Sepher.)

primaryChecks.text: They gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had said, and he drove the three sons of Anak out of there.
primaryChecks.nextContext: The children of Benjamin didn’t drive out the Jebusites who inhabited Jerusalem, but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.

primaryChecks.text: Samson lay until midnight, then arose at midnight and took hold of the doors of the gate of the city, with the two posts, and plucked them up, bar and all, and put them on his shoulders and carried them up to the top of the mountain that is before Hebron.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Samson said to them, “This time I will be blameless in the case of the Philistines when I harm them.”
primaryChecks.nextContext: It came to pass afterward that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.
